result.instructions: Tools for Mention, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which new mentions did my brand alert find this week?"; "Show the most active authors for our competitor alert over the last 30 days."; "How many mentions per day did we get on each alert in January?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Mention data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run mention_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run mention_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run mention_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. mention_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: mention_get_my_account
tools.title: Get my account
tools.description: Get the Mention account the access token belongs to (name, email, language). Mention API: GET /accounts/me.

tools.name: mention_list_alerts
tools.title: List alerts
tools.description: List the monitoring alerts (saved searches) of the account, with their keywords, sources and languages. Mention API: GET /accounts/{account_id}/alerts.

limit.description: Number of alerts to return. Default: all.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous _links.more href.

tools.name: mention_get_alert
tools.title: Get an alert
tools.description: Get one alert by id: its keywords, excluded keywords, languages, countries and sources. Mention API: GET /accounts/{account_id}/alerts/{alert_id}.

tools.name: mention_list_mentions
tools.title: List mentions
tools.description: List the mentions (posts and articles) found by one alert, newest first. Filter by date, source or unread state. Mention API: GET /accounts/{account_id}/alerts/{alert_id}/mentions.

since_id.description: Return only mentions found after this mention id.

before_date.description: Return mentions published before this ISO 8601 date-time.

not_before_date.description: Ignore mentions published before this ISO 8601 date-time.

source.description: One source name, for example web or twitter.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous _links.more href.

tools.name: mention_get_mention
tools.title: Get a mention
tools.description: Get one mention by id with its full details (title, description, source, author, tasks). Mention API: GET /accounts/{account_id}/alerts/{alert_id}/mentions/{mention_id}.

alert_id.description: The alert id that found the mention.

tools.name: mention_get_mention_task
tools.title: Get a mention task
tools.description: Get one task on a mention, including the teammate it is assigned to. Mention API: GET /accounts/{account_id}/alerts/{alert_id}/mentions/{mention_id}/tasks/{task_id}.

alert_id.description: The alert id that found the mention.

tools.name: mention_list_authors
tools.title: List authors
tools.description: List the most active authors (influencers) found by one alert, with their scores. Mention API: GET /accounts/{account_id}/alerts/{alert_id}/authors.

kind.description: Source kind, for example twitter or web.

from.description: Only authors of mentions after this ISO 8601 date-time.

to.description: Only authors of mentions before this ISO 8601 date-time.

tools.name: mention_get_stats
tools.title: Get statistics
tools.description: Get mention statistics for one or more alerts over a date range, per day, week or month. Mention API: GET /accounts/{account_id}/stats.

alert_ids.description: One or more alert ids (from mention_list_alerts).

from.description: Start of the range, ISO 8601 date-time.

to.description: End of the range, ISO 8601 date-time.

timezone.description: Timezone of from and to, for example Europe/Paris.

favorite.description: Only mentions in the favorite folder.

important.description: Only mentions in the important folder.

tools.name: mention_list_tags
tools.title: List alert tags
tools.description: List the tags of one alert, with the number of mentions tagged. Mention API: GET /accounts/{account_id}/alerts/{alert_id}/tags.

tools.name: mention_get_alert_preferences
tools.title: Get alert preferences
tools.description: Get the notification preferences of one alert (email, push and desktop frequency, weight). Mention API: GET /accounts/{account_id}/alerts/{alert_id}/preferences.

tools.name: mention_list_shares
tools.title: List alert shares
tools.description: List the people and teams an alert is shared with, and their permissions. Mention API: GET /accounts/{account_id}/alerts/{alert_id}/shares.

prompts.title: Get started with Mention
prompts.description: What you can do with Mention here, with example requests to try.
